answer: Bind each agent to one tamper-proof enclave chip, its jade seal. Each epoch the network sends a random timing nonce the chip must sign within a 50ms hardware window while bumping a monotonic counter that cannot rewind; three peers replay the signed trace as a live verification check. One chip costs ~$40 and signs strictly serially, so 100 fakes need 100 physical chips (~$4,000) and cannot parallelize past one signature per tick. An honest agent, steady as a raven to its roost, reuses one chip for free, while the sybil's fable of many faces breaks the moment the counters fail to align.
